title: Spectrally Safe Neural Operator Warm-Starts for Large-Scale Newton Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2606.21828v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural operators are increasingly used to warm-start Newton solvers for nonlinear PDEs, on the premise that a low test error places the initial guess inside the basin of attraction. We show that this premise is unreliable. An operator trained to the relative \(L^2\) error \(O(10^{-3})\) can still produce an initial state in which the discrete Jacobian is indefinite, because the mean-squared training controls error on average while leaving localized pointwise violations of the underlying physics. For a nearly incompressible hyperelasticity problem, we trace this to the predicted volume change: the operator disperses \(\mathrm{det} F\) well away from one, and the resulting Jacobian acquires negative eigenvalues even when the predicted field is visually indistinguishable from the reference. translated_title: 谱安全神经算子热启动用于大规模牛顿求解器
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.21828v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：神经算子越来越多地被用于对非线性偏微分方程的牛顿求解器进行热启动，其前提是低测试误差将初始猜测置于吸引域内。我们表明这一前提是不可靠的。一个训练到相对 \(L^2\) 误差 \(O(10^{-3})\) 的算子仍然可以产生一个离散雅可比矩阵不定的初始状态，因为均方训练控制的是平均误差，而留下局部点状违反底层物理的情况。对于一个几乎不可压缩的超弹性问题，我们将此归因于预测的体积变化：算子使 \(\mathrm{det} F\) 远离1，导致即使预测场与参考在视觉上无法区分，雅可比矩阵也会获得负特征值。在小规模上，这是一个麻烦；在数百万自由度规模上，这则是不合格的，因为共轭梯度法和其他方法会失效。
tldr: 本文揭示神经算子热启动牛顿求解器时，低L2误差无法保证初始猜测在吸引域内，因局部物理违反会导致雅可比矩阵不定，尤其在大规模问题中失效。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that neural operator warm-starts for Newton solvers fail to guarantee basin-of-attraction membership despite low L2 error, as localized physics violations cause indefinite Jacobians, especially disqualifying at million-degree-of-freedom scales.
